hypotheses.title: Piotroski Quality x Profitability Synergy (model16 Virgin Style Surface)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Explores the fundamental Piotroski style surfaces. Firms exhibiting both superior balance sheet quality/solvency (fscore_quality) and high operating profitability (fscore_profitability) generate durable competitive moats. Multiplicative interaction shapes a 2D synergy surface requiring simultaneous strength in both dimensions. Completely virgin field pair with 0 prior candidate history.
confounders: Capital-intensive industries where balance sheet debt is structurally high
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails during low-quality speculative rallies where distressed firms outperform high-quality profitable firms.

hypotheses.title: Synthetic Options Forward Price Carry Spread (option9 Put-Call Parity)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Synthetic forward prices derived from option put-call parity reflect the implied cost of financing, dividend discount expectations, and institutional borrow demand. Stocks trading at an implied discount to synthetic forward price ((forward_price_60 - close)/close) offer harvestable cash-and-carry risk premia. Completely untouched in portfolio.
confounders: Unannounced dividend cuts altering forward strike pricing
hypotheses.falsification_test: Breaks down during severe corporate short squeezes where negative borrow fees distort forward pricing.

hypotheses.title: Empirical 30-Day Low-Beta Anomaly (model51 Market Sensitivity)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: One of the most persistent empirical asset pricing phenomena: high-beta assets deliver lower risk-adjusted returns due to leverage-constrained retail investors chasing lottery payoffs. Long low-beta equities within each subindustry via -beta_last_30_days_spy captures this structural mispricing with 98% coverage. Zero portfolio overlap.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Underperforms during explosive bull market breakouts where market beta exposure is heavily rewarded.
